stories.title: Summer school at Coleg Cambria prepares school leavers for future success
stories.summary: Record numbers of school leavers are taking their first steps towards the future at Coleg Cambria after enrolling on its expanded Jobs Growth Wales+ summer school. stories.title: Man and his dog complete 870-mile walk in memory of wife
stories.summary: A retiree from North Wales and his loyal four-legged friend have completed an epic 870-mile fundraising challenge in aid of the hospice that care for his late wife, Debbie. stories.title: “Much more than just a symbolic gesture”: Flintshire signs the Young Carers Covenant
stories.summary: Around 800 young carers are currently known to services in Flintshire, and some of them took on caring responsibilities from the age of four. Flintshire County Council has signed the Young Carers Covenant, a UK-wide pledge covering young carers and young adult carers up to the age of 25. Councillors voted unanimously to sign it

stories.title: Flint IT firm Layer 4 signs three-year partnership with Chester FC
stories.summary: A company based in Flint has signed a three-year deal with Chester FC. Layer 4 Limited, a managed IT services firm, will be a club partner for the next three seasons.
